name: Chewable Aspirin (325 mg)
cautions: Strictly contraindicated if allergic to aspirin/NSAIDs or if active internal bleeding suspected.

name: Sublingual Nitroglycerin (0.4 mg spray)
cautions: Do NOT administer if systolic blood pressure is below 90 mmHg or if heart rate is below 50 bpm.

name: Emergency Medical O2 Delivery Mask
cautions: Confirm high-flow seal; monitor habitat ambient O2 levels to avoid hyperoxic flammability risk.

name: Ondansetron (4 mg ODT)
cautions: Effective for solar storm radiation-induced nausea; screen for cardiac QT interval lengthening.

name: WHO Oral Electrolyte Rehydration Salts
cautions: Dissolve in 500 mL sterile potable water. Essential for fluid loss during acute nausea or heat stress.

name: Epinephrine Auto-Injector (0.3 mg)
cautions: For acute anaphylactic shock or severe airway compromise.

name: Acetaminophen / Paracetamol (500 mg)
cautions: Safe first-line analgesic for patients allergic to aspirin or NSAIDs.

name: Active Electronic Personal Dosimeter (EPD)
cautions: Verify calibration status and clip to torso under flight suit.
